headline: Reduced-order models link mutations and conformational changes to protein dynamics
label: Coarse Grained Conformational Dynamics
summary: Recent work pairs coarse-grained, sparse, and short-MD-guided models with targeted scans to predict conformational transitions and mutation effects.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the use of reduced representations to extract mutational and conformational information from protein structure and short dynamics. StructureDCA restricts direct couplings to spatially contacting residues and can add relative solvent accessibility to improve mutational landscape predictions. ICed-ENM applies an internal-coordinate elastic network with a mutation-scanning pipeline that scores impact via vibrational entropy, while conformational scanning decouples SSE topology from geometry to mine the PDB for conformational homologues. The published study shows that anharmonic low-frequency vibrations from short MD runs can guide enhanced sampling toward conformational transitions and free energies. The new element is the coupling of specific structural encodings, namely contact sparsity, internal coordinates, and topology-geometry separation, to particular prediction tasks.
